semiconductor_relevance: Medium — CEJN Korea specializes in quick connect solutions for fluid control, which are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CEJN Korea Co., Ltd. is a Swedish company that provides innovative quick connect solutions, particularly for hydraulic and liquid cooling applications in the semiconductor industry. Their UltraFlow SC series is specifically designed for liquid cooling systems used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, ensuring reliable performance and environmental safety.
capabilities: Quick connect solutions for hydraulic and liquid cooling
UltraFlow SC series for semiconductor equipment cooling
High-pressure hydraulic products for industrial applications

regional_presence.Korea: CEJN Korea operates in Korea, focusing on providing solutions for the semiconductor and industrial sectors.
